name: IndiaTVDNA Search Optimization Toolkit
author: IndiaTVDNA | WordPress Plugins & Themes

sections.description:
IndiaTVDNA Search Optimization Toolkit Free includes working metadata management, XML sitemaps, Schema.org output, redirects, 404 monitoring, content audits, social metadata, internal-link tools, WooCommerce/EDD integrations (when installed), local SEO, and optional integrations that need your own provider credentials. Basic SEO features work without registration, payment or license key.

The catalog contains 122 separately listed tool entries (including shortcut views). 114 are included in Free. Eight separate commercial capabilities have informational previews only: AI Brand Visibility; AI Image Generator MAX; SERP Analytics MAX; Backlink Workbench MAX; Agency Center 2.0; Report Builder MAX; Growth Suite MAX; SEO Role Manager MAX. Their processing code and request handlers are not distributed in this package. The admin-only previews do not simulate SEO results, contain active forms or create external API requests. They are not trial-limited Free functionality; users can keep using all 114 Free tools without upgrading.

Learn about the separately distributed premium edition at https://indiatvdna.com/product-category/wordpress/wordpress-plugins/search-optimization-toolkit-pro/. This is a verified product-category listing rather than a direct checkout URL. The Free plugin does not purchase, unlock or automatically install premium code. Free receives updates through the normal WordPress.org system.

External services and privacy

Core titles, metadata, on-site schema, XML sitemaps, and local redirects do not require accounts with external providers. Optional integrations can send information from your WordPress site to the selected service when an administrator explicitly configures a provider, requests analysis, or enables a scheduled integration. Read the provider’s terms and privacy policy before using the service. API use can incur charges and is not required for core Free SEO.

  • Google Search Console / URL Inspection / OAuth: reads site analytics, search performance and index status for the connected Google property. Requests send the authorized property URL and selected page URLs, along with Google OAuth tokens. https://developers.google.com/webmaster-tools and https://policies.google.com/privacy
  • Google Analytics 4 / Measurement Protocol: sends measurement identifiers and selected events or ecommerce data when enabled, and may retrieve authorized reports. https://developers.google.com/analytics and https://policies.google.com/privacy
  • Google PageSpeed Insights: sends page URLs selected for performance checking. https://developers.google.com/speed/docs/insights/v5/get-started and https://policies.google.com/privacy
  • Google Merchant API: optionally sends product/catalog information, account identifiers and OAuth authorization for a connected Merchant account. https://developers.google.com/merchant/api and https://policies.google.com/privacy
  • Google Gemini: sends prompts and any selected site/page content or media to the configured Gemini model. https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api and https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/terms
  • Google Autocomplete / Trends: keyword research may request entered keywords or country identifiers. https://trends.google.com and https://policies.google.com/privacy
  • Microsoft Bing Webmaster Tools: sends site URLs, sitemap addresses or index submissions using the authorized webmaster connection. https://www.bing.com/webmasters and https://www.microsoft.com/privacy/privacystatement
  • IndexNow: submits configured URL(s) and host/key to participating indexing endpoints after IndexNow is enabled. https://www.indexnow.org and https://www.indexnow.org/documentation
  • AI model APIs: configurable OpenAI (https://platform.openai.com), Anthropic (https://www.anthropic.com), Perplexity (https://www.perplexity.ai), DeepSeek (https://www.deepseek.com), Groq (https://groq.com), and xAI (https://x.ai) integrations may transmit prompts, excerpts, page metadata, selected images, and provider credentials to the selected provider. Refer to each vendor’s published API terms/privacy policy. Nothing is sent to all of these providers by default.
  • DataForSEO / SerpApi: when enabled, selected keyword, domain, backlinks/search-metric queries and provider credentials are sent to https://dataforseo.com or https://serpapi.com respectively; refer to their provider terms/privacy policies.

Do not send private drafts, personal information or confidential content to external AI providers unless your data-processing basis allows it. Scheduled remote features should remain off unless explicitly configured. This Free plugin does not connect to IndiaTVDNA’s store to check licenses and does not require registration.

Upgrade from 1.0.3

The plugin directory slug and main plugin filename are preserved for normal WordPress.org updates. Existing SEO-related WordPress options should be retained; this release expands the feature set. Verify site-specific settings, sitemaps, redirects, metadata and external connections on a staging copy before upgrading production installations. Do not activate this build simultaneously with a separate IndiaTVDNA SEO Master installation.
sections.installation:
1. Back up site files and database, preferably with a staging copy.
  2. Upload the Free ZIP via Plugins > Add New or install from WordPress.org when approved.
  3. Activate, then open IndiaTVDNA SEO Master to verify titles, XML sitemap, robots.txt and published page metadata.
  4. Configure any external providers only if wanted. They are optional.
  5. For sites previously running the private Pro package, keep a backup. Free preserves stored settings but will not run removed premium services or their historical scheduled tasks.
sections.faq:
Can I use Free without upgrading?

Yes. No Free tool is disabled by a purchase requirement, timer or quota.

Why do I see eight PRO pages?

They are labeled informational previews for separately sold software. Disabled visual fields only illustrate the commercial interface; Free code does not pretend to execute them.

Do I need API keys?

No keys are required for core titles, metadata, sitemap, schema and redirects. Some optional external tools require provider configuration and may incur third-party charges.
sections.changelog:
1.5.109

  • Stop re-registering removed Pro-only cron tasks and clean up migration schedules on existing installations.
  • Restore a functional Free Infrastructure & Schema Audit page and correct its Save/Run redirects.
  • Expand third-party service disclosures for WordPress.org review.
  • This is a local release candidate; official Plugin Check and complete live testing remain necessary.

1.5.108

  • Initial WordPress.org Free-edition candidate split from version 1.5.107.
  • Retained 114 Free catalog entries; replaced eight external advanced tools with admin-only informational previews.
  • Removed premium-only job handlers, proprietary AI visibility/advanced growth modules and private updater/rollback implementation.
  • Added contextual Buy Pro links and transparent PRO labeling.
  • Staging review candidate only; WordPress.org approval and complete live end-to-end verification are not yet established.
